description: social.md §2: t_obs, t_eff, the 5-minute future clamp, the declaration lower bound t_decl, the causal lower bound through the placed thread, and the inconsistent-timestamps flag. input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: tDecl (µs), times: {uri: {tRank, futureDated, inconsistentTimestamps}} for every candidate item that V1 does not exclude. Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: honest-post-and-comment
vectors.note: claimed time = TID time = first-seen time: t_rank is the claimed time

vectors.name: future-dated-just-under-5-min
vectors.note: t_eff = t_obs + 299999999 µs; future(x) ⇔ t_eff > t_obs + 300000000

vectors.name: future-dated-exactly-5-min
vectors.note: t_eff = t_obs + 300000000 µs; future(x) ⇔ t_eff > t_obs + 300000000

vectors.name: future-dated-just-over-5-min
vectors.note: t_eff = t_obs + 300000001 µs; future(x) ⇔ t_eff > t_obs + 300000000

vectors.name: future-dated-post-and-reply-clamped
vectors.note: both claim a time a day or more after first-seen: each ranks at its first-seen time, and the reply is still bounded below by its parent

vectors.name: future-claim-without-obs-stands
vectors.note: no obs entry for the item (vectors only): the claimed time stands and the item is not flagged future-dated (§2.3)

vectors.name: claim-earlier-than-tid
vectors.note: t_claim = T0+2h < t_tid = T0+6h: t_eff = t_claim; |t_claim − t_tid| = 4 h > 1 h flags inconsistent timestamps

vectors.name: tid-earlier-than-claim
vectors.note: a far-future createdAt is harmless when the TID is honest: t_eff = t_tid; not future-dated (t_eff ≤ t_obs + 5 min), but inconsistent

vectors.name: inconsistent-timestamps-exactly-1-h
vectors.note: |t_claim − t_tid| = 3600000000 µs; the flag needs > 3600000000

vectors.name: inconsistent-timestamps-just-over-1-h
vectors.note: |t_claim − t_tid| = 3600000001 µs; the flag needs > 3600000000

vectors.name: tid-clock-id-ignored
vectors.note: tidTime drops the 10-bit clock id (clock id 1023 here)

vectors.name: claimed-time-offsets-and-truncation
vectors.note: µs(createdAt): fraction digits beyond the sixth are truncated; offsets convert to UTC

vectors.name: pre-epoch-createdAt-has-no-claim
vectors.note: valid atproto datetimes before 1970 give µs = None: t_eff = t_tid, and no inconsistent-timestamps flag (t_claim absent)

vectors.name: unparseable-createdAt-excludes-the-item
vectors.note: createdAt '2026-01-01' is not a datetime, so the comment fails G2 and is Excluded (no t_rank); its reply hangs under a Missing placeholder and is bounded by the root post

vectors.name: comment-claimed-before-its-parent
vectors.note: claims (and TIDs) before the post: the comment ranks at the post's t_rank, and its reply at the comment's

vectors.name: chain-is-monotone
vectors.note: t_rank never decreases down a chain: 5h, max(5h, 4h) = 5h, 7h

vectors.name: parent-missing-bounded-by-root
vectors.note: the parent is not in records: the comment sits under a Missing placeholder, so its lower bound is the root post's t_rank (§2.2 treeParent)

vectors.name: root-missing-bounded-by-decl
vectors.note: the root post is not in records: the lower bound is t_decl

vectors.name: root-excluded-bounded-by-decl
vectors.note: the root post fails PO3 (its title is only White_Space) and is Excluded; NOTES.md 3: an Excluded root counts as not in records, so the comment's lower bound is t_decl

vectors.name: orphaned-comment-bounded-by-root
vectors.note: c1 (bob) and c2 (carol) name each other as parent and are claimed and keyed before the post (T0 + 10 and 12 min; the post T0 + 100 min). The greater uri, carol's, is re-attached to the root (Orphaned), so its lower bound is the post's t_rank, and bob's comment, now its child, is bounded by it: all three rank at T0 + 100 min

vectors.name: decl-obs-moves-a-non-future-item-decl-seen-at-creation
vectors.note: adam's post is claimed and keyed at T0 − 5 min and first seen at T0 + 1 min (not future-dated). The declaration's createdAt is T0; first seen at T0, so t_decl = T0 and the post ranks at T0. t_obs(decl) is outside inputDigest, so the two vectors of this pair have equal digests (fold/digest.json) and different t_rank values

vectors.name: decl-obs-moves-a-non-future-item-decl-seen-before-creation
vectors.note: adam's post is claimed and keyed at T0 − 5 min and first seen at T0 + 1 min (not future-dated). The declaration's createdAt is T0; first seen at T0 − 10 min, so its createdAt is more than 5 min after t_obs and is clamped: t_decl = T0 − 10 min, and the post ranks at its own T0 − 5 min. t_obs(decl) is outside inputDigest, so the two vectors of this pair have equal digests (fold/digest.json) and different t_rank values

vectors.name: edited-badge
vectors.note: the [edited] badge: p1 was created before 1970 (no µs) and updated at T0 + 20 min, which counts as later (§20.1 item 46); p2 has the same createdAt and no updatedAt; p3's updatedAt equals its createdAt; p4's updatedAt is before 1970 (no µs) and never makes an item edited; carol's comment has a valid op: update revision (its createdAt is unchanged)

vectors.name: items-claimed-before-the-declaration
vectors.note: posts, wikiRevisions and sequences are bounded below by t_decl

vectors.name: declaration-future-dated-just-under
vectors.note: decl.createdAt = t_obs(decl) + 299999999 µs; t_decl falls back to t_obs(decl) only beyond 5 minutes (c > o + 300000000)

vectors.name: declaration-future-dated-exactly
vectors.note: decl.createdAt = t_obs(decl) + 300000000 µs; t_decl falls back to t_obs(decl) only beyond 5 minutes (c > o + 300000000)

vectors.name: declaration-future-dated-just-over
vectors.note: decl.createdAt = t_obs(decl) + 300000001 µs; t_decl falls back to t_obs(decl) only beyond 5 minutes (c > o + 300000000)

vectors.name: declaration-without-obs
vectors.note: no obs for the declaration: t_decl = µs(createdAt)

vectors.name: declaration-pre-epoch
vectors.note: µs(decl.createdAt) = None (before 1970) gives c = 0, and the declaration has no obs entry, so t_decl = 0

vectors.name: missing-createdAt-excludes-the-item
vectors.note: createdAt is required: the post without it fails G2, is Excluded (V1) and has no t_rank

vectors.name: future-dated-through-the-tid-alone
vectors.note: createdAt is before 1970 (t_claim = None), so t_eff = t_tid = T0+2d, which is more than 5 minutes after t_obs = T0+1h: future-dated, ranked at first-seen

vectors.name: hidden-items-keep-their-time
vectors.note: t_rank reads only validity, obs, decl and placement: the owner's hide of the post changes nothing, and the reply is still bounded below by the hidden post

vectors.name: edit-keeps-first-seen
vectors.note: obs has both versions (T0+1h, T0+10h); t_obs is their minimum and the edit changes nothing

vectors.name: future-check-uses-the-earliest-version
vectors.note: the earliest version was seen 6 min before the claimed time: future-dated, clamped to that first-seen time although the current version was seen later
